notes_for_editor: The brief has agency null; the Texas lookout list places Moss Hill under Angelina National Forest, so that is added as a fact, not a correction. The 1949 NGS page gives no coordinates, and it names the observed point as the center of the tower base. No source found describes removal or the site today. The agency rests on the Texas lookout list page alone. Revised 2026-10-10: the story's wording is rewritten away from the quoted phrases, the crest-of-ridge quote is added as evidence, and the agency quote now carries the site name.
